reasons: Cited paragraphs 11.1-11.3 satisfy all three preferred-position elements: up to six months' transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason, return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification.

Terms are at or better than the playbook ask (rates fixed to the expiring Order Form rather than then-current rates; no withholding for fee disputes; deletion only after Customer confirms successful return), so no redline or counterparty comment is warranted.
Consistent with the claimed compliant status: no redline and no comment were proposed, and the deterministic check confirms transition/data-return language is present.
